name: local-ai-harness
description: A lightweight web application for connecting to locally hosted language models through an OpenAI-compatible API.

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:backend & pnpm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter backend format && pnpm --filter frontend format
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter backend clean && pnpm --filter frontend clean
